transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I guess I just... I've been catching myself thinking lately that it might be easier if I just didn't wake up. I mean, I haven't made any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. Just... having those thoughts, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way, and have these thoughts been happening every day, or come and go?

I don't know... I guess it's been about three months. Just... this low spell that's been hanging on since I had a... a crash back then. It's mostly just... there in the background. Most days, I suppose.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends, don’t interest you as much anymore?

Yeah, I guess so. I just... I don't know, I quit caring about the stuff that usually settles me down. Used to like going fishing, or... digging through old vinyl records. Tailgating, too. Even checking on my home-brew. Now it all just... it just feels like a chore, you know? So I don't bother.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or lacking energy, even when you haven’t done much physically?

I don't know... not really. I mean, I'm on my feet a lot at the store, so I'm always a little beat by the end of the day. But... no, I wouldn't say it's any worse than normal. Just regular tired, I guess.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately, like not being able to fall asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping more than usual?

Well... sleep's been a bit off, I guess. I mean, I do get to sleep, but... I end up waking up way before the sun's even up. Just lying there. My stomach gets all knotted up, and... I don't know, my head just starts spinning about bills, or things I did wrong. Just... can't seem to turn it off once I'm up.
Would you say you feel depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah... I suppose. After that, uh... that big burst of energy I had a while back wore off, it just... it felt like somebody pulled the plug on me. Most days I just end up sitting at the table, staring at my coffee. Just feeling... empty. And ashamed, I guess.
Would you say that your mood has been down or depressed most of the time, nearly every day?

I mean... yeah, like I was just saying. Most days. Once that energy I had just went away, it was like the plug got pulled on me. I just sit at the table with my coffee... feeling empty. And ashamed. So... yes. Pretty much all the time.
Would you say you’ve lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like fishing or checking on your home-brew?

Yeah. I guess so. I just... I haven't really cared much about any of that lately. Fishing, digging through my vinyls... even checking on the home-brew. It all just... feels like a chore now. I don't know. I just don't have it in me.
Have you had any other periods in your life where you felt this way before, or is this the first time your mood has been like this?
I don't know... maybe? I try not to dwell on it. I guess there have been times I felt a bit low before, but... I don't really keep track.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
I don't really know. Like I said... I don't keep track of the days. Two weeks is a long time. If I did, I... I guess I just didn't notice. I usually just go to work and keep my head down.
Have you ever had a time before this one where you felt this low for a long period, to the point where it affected your work or home life?
I... I don't think so. I mean, I've always managed to get to work. I just... I do my shifts. I don't really let things get in the way of that. I'm just tired right now.
Before this current period, has there ever been a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt better for a while before this happened again?

I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really had some kind of pattern like that. Like I said, I just go to the store, do my hours, and go home. I don't really remember feeling this way before. It's just... this is just how it is right now.

Before this current low spell, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt better for at least a few months before this happened again?
No. I mean... I already told you. I don't keep track of things like that. I haven't had anything like that happen. I just... I just want to rest.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating a lot more or less than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I guess... I haven't really been eating much. Most days I kind of have to remind myself to eat. Supper just... it just sits there. Seems like too much trouble. My jeans feel a little looser, I suppose.

Before this current episode started, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt better for at least a few months before this current episode began?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said before, no. I don't remember anything like that happening. It's just a no.
Before this current episode started, did you ever have a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, then felt better for a while, and now this is happening again?
I... look, you keep asking me the exact same thing. I already told you no. I haven't had anything like that. Can we just move on?
Before this current low spell started, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, then felt better for a while, and now this is happening again?
I... I don't know what you want me to say. I just answered that. Are you even listening to me? The answer is still no.

Before this current low spell started, have you ever had a period of time where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then felt better for a while before this current episode began?
I... I really don't understand why we're still on this. I've said no three times now. I just... no. I haven't.

Before this current low spell started, have you ever had a period where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt better for at least a few months before this current episode began?
Look... no. I don't have anything else to tell you about this. The answer is just no.
